description: Run a check for NEW filings RIGHT NOW (on all your watches, or one by id) — this actually queries the register, unlike list_watches which only shows what you have. Returns JSON with only the filings that appeared since the watch started / last check, scored by risk. Use this when you want fresh results immediately; the scheduled checker also runs daily at 09:00 on each watch's own cadence (daily by default). SCREEN ONLY — not clearance, not legal advice.

id.description: Watch id to check alone; omit to check all

name: check_watches
